g.text: A platinum RTD converts temperature to a measured resistance

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Pt100 linear approximation α=0.00385 K⁻¹ over this illustrated range. At 100°C R≈138.5 Ω and 1 mA gives 138.5 mV. Two-wire schematic includes unshown lead
resistance; 3/4-wire methods reduce that error. Excitation can cause self-heating. Exact platinum response is nonlinear.
